content: Although we acknowledge that the proposed methodology does not serve as a replacement of manual analysis of OSG for the presence of therapeutic factors, we believe that it could facilitate and supplement this process. The method can serve as a tool for general practitioners and psychologists who can use it as an additional source of information regarding their patients’ condition and, in turn, offer a more personalised support that is better tailored to individual therapeutic needs.
